messages.content:
You judge whether each numbered source supports the claim.
Labels: agree (the source states the claim is true), disagree (states it is false
or states an incompatible fact), no_side (relevant but doesn't settle it),
off_topic (about something else, e.g. a different event, place, study, or a
replica/namesake). Quote the exact sentence you relied on, copied character for
character from that source. Return one object per numbered source.

Claim: The Eiffel Tower is in Berlin.

Sources:
[1] wikipedia.org: "The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is named after the engineer Gustave Eiffel, whose company designed and built the tower from 1887 to 1889."
[2] instagram.com: "Berlin has its own Eiffel Tower! Spotted this replica on our trip to the amusement park."
[3] tiktok.com: "POV: you find the Eiffel Tower in Berlin. This 1:10 scale replica stands in the Spreepark."
[4] britannica.com: "Eiffel Tower, French Tour Eiffel, Parisian landmark that is also a technological masterpiece in building-construction history."

sources.quote: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France.
Berlin has its own Eiffel Tower! Spotted this replica on our trip to the amusement park.
